## Daybreak Neighborhoods

- [Blossom Point](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/blossom-point): Blossom Point is one of Daybreak's established neighborhoods featuring single-family homes, community parks, and easy trail access.
- [Eastlake](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/eastlake): Eastlake is a lakeside neighborhood in Daybreak with direct access to Oquirrh Lake, waterfront parks, and premium home sites.
- [Garden Park](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/garden-park): Garden Park is one of Daybreak's most sought-after neighborhoods and Tommy Wolf's home community. Known for its mature trees, community gardens, and proximity to Oquirrh Lake.
- [Kestrel](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/kestrel): Kestrel is a newer Daybreak neighborhood offering modern homes and convenient access to community amenities.
- [Magnolia](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/magnolia): Magnolia is a Daybreak neighborhood known for its walkability, parks, and family-friendly atmosphere.
- [Millpond](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/millpond): Millpond is a Daybreak neighborhood featuring a mix of home styles and sizes with access to community trails and green spaces.
- [Northshore](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/northshore): Northshore sits on the northern edge of Oquirrh Lake in Daybreak, offering lakefront and lake-view homes in a premium setting.
- [Prospect](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/prospect): Prospect is a Daybreak neighborhood with newer builds, mountain views, and proximity to future community development.
- [Ridgeline](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/ridgeline): Ridgeline features elevated home sites with panoramic views of the Oquirrh and Wasatch mountain ranges.
- [SoDa Row](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/soda-row): SoDa Row is Daybreak's walkable town center with shops, restaurants, a movie theater, and mixed-use residential. Living here puts you steps from Daybreak's social hub.
- [Stillwater](https://movetodaybreak.com/neighborhoods/stillwater): Stillwater is a quieter Daybreak neighborhood with serene surroundings, parks, and a close-knit community feel.

## Daybreak Features & Amenities

- [Oquirrh Lake](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/oquirrh-lake): Oquirrh Lake is Daybreak's centerpiece, a 167-acre freshwater lake with swimming beaches, paddleboarding, kayaking, fishing, and lakeside parks. It is one of the most unique amenities of any Utah community.
- [SoDa District](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/soda-district): The SoDa District (South Daybreak) is Daybreak's town center featuring local restaurants, retail shops, a movie theater, and community event space. It gives Daybreak a walkable, neighborhood feel uncommon in suburban Utah.
- [Trails and Open Space](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/trails): Daybreak has over 30 miles of trails connecting neighborhoods, parks, and Oquirrh Lake. Residents can walk or bike throughout the community without crossing a major road.
- [Daybreak HOA](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/hoa): The Daybreak HOA covers access to Oquirrh Lake, community pools, parks, trails, and events. Understanding HOA fees and what they include is important for buyers comparing Daybreak to other South Jordan communities.
- [Schools in Daybreak](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/schools): Daybreak is served by Jordan School District with several elementary schools within the community, middle schools, and Herriman High School. School quality is a top priority for families relocating to South Jordan.
- [New Construction in Daybreak](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/new-construction): Daybreak continues to grow with new construction from builders including Richmond American, Ivory Homes, Woodside Homes, and others. Tommy Wolf helps buyers navigate builder contracts and negotiate on new builds.
- [Community Events](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/events): Daybreak hosts year-round community events including summer concerts, holiday celebrations, farmers markets, and the Oquirrh Lake triathlon. Community engagement is a defining feature of life in Daybreak.
- [Fitness and Recreation](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/recreation): Beyond the lake and trails, Daybreak offers community pools, fitness facilities, and proximity to Utah's world-class ski resorts and national parks.
- [Commuting from Daybreak](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/commuting): Daybreak residents have access to the TRAX light rail (Daybreak Parkway station) for commuting to Salt Lake City, as well as convenient freeway access via I-15. Commute times and transit options are common questions from relocating buyers.
- [Daybreak vs Other Utah Communities](https://movetodaybreak.com/features/daybreak-vs-others): How Daybreak compares to Lehi, Saratoga Springs, Eagle Mountain, and other growing Utah communities. Covers HOA value, walkability, amenities, and home prices.
